phase: Baseline assessment and first correction; no 10x improvement demonstrated
limitations: Single cold sample; at most three repeat samples per journey.
Failed readiness windows are censored, not successful latency measurements.
Profiles share a User and retained server state; cold clears only browser HTTP cache.
Request totals span different completed journeys and are not comparable tier benchmarks.
No-request autosave observations do not measure writes.
Installed Chromium differs from repository-pinned version; local uncompressed preview is not hosted edge delivery.
